hero.footer: Aisa call aksar thagi se kuch minute pehle aata hai.
hero.title: Paise bhejne se pehle, ek button asli parivaar se pooch leta hai.
hero.body: Asli hai? mata-pita ko wapas call karta hai, aur jis family member ke naam se call aaya tha use bhi call karta hai, jab tak mata-pita line par rehte hain. Phir unki apni bhasha mein batata hai ki call asli tha ya nahi.
demo.title: Ek check dekhiye
demo.body: Chuniye kya hua aur call kis bhasha mein hai, phir Play dabaiye. Dono call saath-saath chalte hain: mata-pita ke phone par Saathi, aur family member ke phone par check. "Fixed" wali lines safety ke liye har baar bilkul yahi boli jaati hain.
log.family: Family member ke call ki baatcheet
sim.note: Timing andaaze se hai aur 3× speed par chalti hai. Aap pause kar sakte hain, ya ek-ek line karke dekh sakte hain.
ev.callback: Saathi Sunita ko wapas call karti hai
ev.safeFires: Server “call nakli” ka faisla Sunita ke call mein bhejta hai
ev.summary: Rahul ko WhatsApp par summary milti hai
ev.wordMatches: Family word match ho gaya. “Call asli” ka faisla Sunita ke call mein pahunchta hai
ev.alert: Rahul ko WhatsApp par alert milta hai
ev.alertMother: Rahul ko maa ko call karne ka WhatsApp alert milta hai
ev.nextContact: Jawab nahi. Server agle family member ko call karta hai
ev.timeout: 75 second mein jawab nahi. “Pakka nahi” ka faisla pahunchta hai
verdict.fake: Call nakli tha. Paise mat bhejiye.
verdict.none: Pakka nahi. Abhi paise mat bhejiye.
how.title: Yeh kaise kaam karta hai
how.body: Bolna par do voice agent aur ek chhota server. Mata-pita ko phone rakhna nahi padta.
how.1.title: Mata-pita ek button dabate hain
how.1.body: Family ya police bankar paise maangne wale ko kuch bhi dene se pehle, phone par rakha peela button dabate hain.
how.2.title: Saathi wapas call karti hai
how.2.body: Do sawaalon mein pata karti hai ki kisne call kiya, kya maanga aur kitna.
how.3.title: Doosra call parivaar se poochta hai
how.3.body: Mata-pita line par rehte hain, aur doosra agent family member se ek haan-ya-na sawaal poochta hai. Haan kehne par family word bhi chahiye.
how.4.title: Faisla usi call mein pahunchta hai
how.4.body: Jawab seedhe mata-pita ke chal rahe call mein pahunchta hai, aur parivaar ko WhatsApp par summary milti hai.
safety.title: Aisa bana hai ki koi isse galat jawab na dilwa sake
safety.1.title: Fixed safety lines
safety.1.body: Har faisla pehle se tay line hai. AI apni taraf se kabhi nahi kehta ki call asli tha.
safety.2.title: Family word AI tak nahi jaata
safety.2.body: Yeh kisi prompt ya log mein nahi hota. Sirf server ise milata hai, English letters mein ya parivaar ki apni script mein.
safety.3.title: “Na” kaafi hai
safety.3.body: Agar family member ne call nahi kiya, to baat saaf hai. “Haan” se paise ja sakte hain, isliye uske saath family word bhi chahiye.
safety.4.title: Lamba intezaar nahi
safety.4.body: Koi phone na uthaye to agle family member ko call hota hai. 75 second mein saaf jawab na mile, to Saathi kehti hai ki khud baat kiye bina paise mat bhejiye.
safety.5.title: Police ya CBI wale call
safety.5.body: “Digital arrest” jaisi koi cheez nahi hoti. Saathi yahi batati hai, call kaatne ko kehti hai, aur paise ja chuke hon to 1930 batati hai.
safety.6.title: Parivaar ki apni bhasha mein
safety.6.body: Saathi Sarvam ke zariye 12 bhashaon mein sunti aur bolti hai, jo parivaar judte samay chunta hai. Hindi mein yahi agent Deepgram aur Cartesia par bhi chalte hain, taaki test calls mein dekha ja sake ki kaun zyada tez aur sahi hai.
langs.title: Saathi parivaar ki bhasha bolti hai
langs.body: 12 bhashayein, jo parivaar judte samay chunta hai. Har call usi bhasha mein shuru hota hai, aur har fixed safety message har bhasha mein likha aur record kiya gaya hai.
langs.caption: Call nakli hone par Saathi kya kehti hai
families.title: Parivaaron ke liye
families.body: Beta ya beti apne mata-pita ke liye ek baar ise set up karte hain.
families.1: Mata-pita, call karne ke liye ek ya do family members, aur ek family word jodiye.
families.2: Mata-pita ke phone par button wala link kholiye aur home screen par add kijiye.
families.3: Unhe bataiye: paise maangne wale kisi ko bhi dene se pehle, peela button dabaiye.
families.caption: Mata-pita ko yahi dikhta hai: unki apni bhasha mein ek bada button.
foot.helpline: Thagi mein paise chale gaye? Turant {tel1930} par call kijiye ya {cyber} par shikayat kijiye.
foot.about: Asli hai? Bolna Buildathon ka project hai. Code {github} par hai.

signup.step2: Menu dabaiye, phir “Add to Home screen” chuniye.
signup.step3: Mata-pita ko bataiye: call par kisi ko bhi paise dene se pehle, peela button dabaiye.

err.phone: 10 digit ka Indian mobile number likhiye.
err.contactPair: Is vyakti ka mobile number likhiye, ya naam hata dijiye.
err.summary: Kuch details theek karni hain. Pehli wali highlight ki gayi hai.
err.invite: Yeh invite code sahi nahi hai. Pilot team se apna code maangiye.
err.duplicate: Yeh number pehle se registered hai.
err.server: Parivaar nahi jud paaya. Details check karke phir koshish kijiye.
err.network: Server tak nahi pahunch paaye. Internet check karke phir koshish kijiye.
call.fake.parent: Mere bete ka phone aaya tha. Bola accident ho gaya hai, pachaas hazaar turant bhejo.
call.holding: Ghabraiye mat, main aapke saath hoon. Us number ka phone mat uthaiye, aur use wapas call mat kijiye.
call.rahul.no: Nahi, maine koi call nahi kiya. Main to office mein hoon.
call.real.parent: Rahul ka naye number se phone aaya tha. Bola phone kho gaya hai, cab ke liye do hazaar chahiye.
call.rahul.yes: Haan, maine hi call kiya tha. Mera phone kho gaya hai.
call.askWord: Theek hai. Pakka karne ke liye apna family word boliye.
call.familyWord: (family word bolte hain; sirf server ise milata hai)
call.verdictReal: Rahul ne khud bataya ki call unhi ka tha, aur family word sahi bola. Yeh call asli hai. Paise sirf usi account mein bhejiye jo Rahul aapko khud bataayein, aur pehle unhe unke purane number par call kar lijiye.
call.cbi.parent: Koi CBI se bol raha tha. Keh raha tha mere naam par case hai, video call par raho aur paise bhejo.
call.cbi.hangup: Achha, main woh call kaat deti hoon.
call.cbi.block: Bilkul sahi. Us number ko block bhi kar dijiye.
call.paid.parent: Maine unhe das hazaar bhej diye, aur OTP bhi bata diya.
call.paid.calling: Theek hai, main abhi 1930 par call karti hoon.
call.none.holding1: Main aapke bete ko call kar rahi hoon, bas thodi der. Us number ka phone mat uthaiye.
call.none.holding2: Main ghar ke doosre member ko bhi call kar rahi hoon. Aap line par bane rahiye.
hero.quote: “Papa, accident ho gaya hai. Jaldi paise bhejo.”
ob.title: Apne mata-pita ke liye Asli hai? set up kijiye

ob.h.first: Aksar woh beta ya beti, jiske naam se thag call kar sakte hain.

ob.q.second: {first} phone na uthayein to Saathi kise call kare?
ob.h.second: Zaroori nahi, par {first} busy hon to kaam aata hai.
ob.h.word: Jab sach mein kisi ko paise chahiye hon, to Saathi {name} ko "call asli hai" batane se pehle yeh word poochegi. Aisa word chuniye jo koi ajnabi internet par na dhoondh sake.
